name: Governance Voting Tool
description_short: Vote and publish rationales on Cardano governance.
description_long: Open-source tool that makes Cardano governance voting practical for SPOs, DReps, and Constitutional Committee members. Supports both VKey and script voters and works with any wallet type — light, hardware, or cold. Beyond casting the vote, it helps compose a vote rationale in the correct JSON metadata format, pin that metadata to IPFS for permanent storage, and generate formatted PDFs of the rationale. Can be self-hosted from a published container. Built with a Python backend and an Elm frontend, Apache-2.0 licensed.
